blocks.zh: 摘要
blocks.en: Abstract

blocks.zh: 虽然从一个单一的人类视频中学习非曲直的操控,为昂贵的机器人演示提供了一个有希望的替代办法,但最近许多方法主要模仿展示的运动. 这种严格的运动比对往往将一般化限制在初始对象的姿势,目标姿势,以及没有在视频中显示的抓取. 或者,通过强化学习(RL)发现某项政策,可以进行广泛的概括,但是,如果没有事先的指导,它就会在复杂、多阶段的任务中与高维度的探索作斗争。 为了应对这些结合的概括和探索挑战,我们提出了Dex-One2Many,一个真实到真实的框架,它从一个单一的人类视频中学习到一个笼统的可调和的操纵政策. 我们的关键洞察力是将视频抽象为引导RL的相继场景图,在保持广泛的通俗性的同时,能够有效探索. 图表是不同重置状态取样的基因限制,为每个阶段提供密集的奖励。 由于图表限制关系而不是精确的姿势,这些重置状态覆盖物体的姿势和抓取到视频之外,同时以密集的奖励从它们中初始化每个阶段则保持了探索的短暂和引导. 完全接受模拟训练,Dex-One2Many将零射入真正的多指手. 在五个工具使用和操纵任务中,Dex-One2Many在所见配置中比基线高出6.5%,而其强力的概括将这一差距扩大至71%。
blocks.en: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.

blocks.zh: 图1:从一个人类视频到许多狡猾的行为. 鉴于一个人类的视频,Dex-One2Many在模拟中完全学习了一种狡猾的政策,并在现实世界中部署零镜头. 通过对各种模拟任务组合的培训,由此产生的政策在视频显示的执行之外,执行许多看不见的配置任务。
blocks.en: Figure 1 : From one human video to many dexterous behaviors. Given one human video of a manipulation task, Dex-One2Many learns a dexterous policy entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot in the real world. By training across diverse simulated task configurations, the resulting policy executes the task across many unseen configurations beyond the execution shown in the video.

blocks.zh: 1 导言
blocks.en: 1 Introduction

blocks.zh: Dexterous操控是使机器人能够进行复杂的物体相互作用的有希望的方向,但收集足够的高质量机器人演示仍然是一大瓶颈. 对于高自由度的手来说,远程操作接口在设计和操作上特别昂贵,所收集的运动与特定的机器人形态有关. 人类的视频可以绕过这个瓶颈:如果没有机器人或远程操作装置,这些视频很容易收集,并包含丰富的关于手-物体相互作用的视觉和动能信息。 最近的方法利用这个方法从仅仅一个人类的视频中吸取了非曲直的操纵(Lum等人,2025年,Paliwal等人,2026年,Han等人,2026年,Zhu等人,2026年).
blocks.en: Dexterous manipulation is a promising direction for enabling robots to perform complex object interactions, but collecting enough high-quality robot demonstrations remains a major bottleneck. For high-degree-of-freedom hands, teleoperation interfaces are particularly costly to design and operate, and the collected motions are tied to a specific robot morphology. Human videos offer a way around this bottleneck: they are easy to collect without a robot or a teleoperation rig and contain rich visual and kinematic information about hand–object interactions. Recent methods exploit this to learn dexterous manipulation from just a single human video ( Lum et al., 2025 , Paliwal et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 , Zhu et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.zh: 然而,这些单视频方法大多将视频转换成执行级的引导,例如重建对象轨迹(Lum等人,2025年),重定向手动(Paliwal等人,2026年,Han等人,2026年),或接触提示(Zhu等人,2026年). 这种指导有助于高维度的灵活政策学习,但也将由此产生的政策与视频中显示的运动和空间配置联系起来。 即使对同样的任务来说,这些方法对初始对象的姿势,目标的姿势,以及没有在视频中显示的抓取方式,都概括不佳.
blocks.en: However, these single-video methods mostly convert the video into execution-level guidance, such as reconstructed object trajectories ( Lum et al., 2025 ) , retargeted hand motions ( Paliwal et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 ) , or contact cues ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Such guidance facilitates high-dimensional dexterous policy learning, but also ties the resulting policy to the motion and spatial configuration shown in the video. Even for the same task, these methods generalize poorly to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video.

blocks.zh: 学习一种超越视频中显示的处决范围的普遍化的狡猾政策,提出了两个紧密结合的挑战. 第一个是任务抽象:决定从视频中保留什么,以及自由留下什么来改变。 保留过多会减少重播被记录的运动的政策;保留过多会让任务描述不足. 第二个问题是难以探索的问题:越是任其变化,政策必须探索的国家空间就越多。 没有执行层面的指导,强化学习(RL)在这种高维空间,特别是在多阶段任务中,难以发现多指,接触丰富的相互作用.
blocks.en: Learning a dexterous policy that generalizes beyond the execution shown in the video raises two tightly coupled challenges. The first is task abstraction : deciding what to preserve from the video and what to leave free to vary. Preserving too much reduces the policy to replaying the recorded motion; preserving too little leaves the task underspecified. The second is a hard exploration problem : the more that is left free to vary, the more of the state space the policy must explore. Without execution-level guidance, reinforcement learning (RL) struggles to discover multi-finger, contact-rich interactions in this high-dimensional space, especially in multi-stage tasks.

blocks.zh: 为了应对这两项挑战,我们提出了Dex-One2Many, 即一个真实到真实的框架, 我们的关键想法是不提取视频的动向,而是提取其任务结构,一个阶段性的场景图,具体说明手-对象和物体-对象关系必须保持何种顺序,同时让RL学习手如何行动。 为此,我们提出了两种技术(图2)。
blocks.en: To address both challenges, we present Dex-One2Many , a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video (Fig. 1 ). Our key idea is to extract not the video’s motion but its task structure, a stage-wise scene graph specifying which hand–object and object–object relations must hold, and in what order, while leaving RL to learn how the hand acts. To this end, we propose two techniques (Fig. 2 ).

blocks.zh: 首先,Page-Wise Scene Graph抽象化将视频减少至任务所需要的关系,如手持一个物体或一个物体停留在容器内,以及其发生的顺序. 物体姿势,目标姿势和抓获仍然可以自由变化. 抽象将视频分解为这些关系改变时的阶段,并将每个阶段编码为手部,物体及其功能部位的上游图. 每个阶段图都描述的不是一个记录状态,而是一组所有保存任务的状态.
blocks.en: First, Stage-Wise Scene Graph Abstraction reduces the video to the relations the task requires, such as the hand holding an object or an object resting inside a container, and to the order in which they occur. Object poses, goal poses, and grasps remain free to vary. The abstraction splits the video into stages when these relations change and encodes each stage as a graph of predicates over the hand, objects, and their functional parts. Each stage graph describes not one recorded state but a set of states that all preserve the task.

blocks.zh: 第二, 场景- Graph- Ground RL使用每个阶段图作为基因约束:它用不同的多指抓法,对满足舞台关系的重置状态进行取样,只保留那些通过模拟检查的状态. 因此,一个视频成为整个工作空间的许多培训状态。 被接受的州构成MDP的初始状态分布,其观察和奖励来自图表. 在每个阶段开始的剧集都便于探索:政策可以在掌握第一部之前练习最后一个阶段,而不是只偶然到达. 在每一个阶段,上游产生的奖励都发出了密集的信号,表明在满足舞台关系方面取得了进展,而没有提及已显示的轨迹。 因此,该政策学习的是任务结构,而不是记录的执行。
blocks.en: Second, Scene-Graph-Grounded RL uses each stage graph as a generative constraint: it samples reset states that satisfy the stage’s relations, with diverse multi-finger grasps, and keeps only those that pass our simulation checks. One video thus becomes many training states across the whole workspace. The accepted states form the initial-state distribution of an MDP whose observations and rewards are derived from the graph. Starting episodes at every stage eases exploration: the policy can practice the last stage before mastering the first, rather than reaching it only by chance. Within each stage, predicate-derived rewards give a dense signal of progress toward satisfying the stage’s relations, without reference to a demonstrated trajectory. The policy therefore learns the task structure rather than the recorded execution.

blocks.zh: 完全接受模拟训练,由此产生的政策完成在真实的多指手势上显示的任务零镜头,横跨初始对象和目标对象的姿势没有在视频中显示. 我们评价了五个任务 包括直接操纵物体 和工具使用 在UR3臂上 用20DoF Wuji 1手。 Dex-One2Many实现60-85%的真实世界成功率, 我们的主要贡献如下: 阶段-视觉场景图摘要: 我们代表着一种人为的演示,作为分阶段的场景图,保留任务定义结构——所需的手-对象和对象-对象关系及其命令——同时放弃特定执行动作。 • 场景加围 RL:我们用每个阶段的场景图来通过任务产生不同的重置状态,使政策能够探索其他的把握和动作,同时从图中将其观察和回报定位。 · 在不见的配置上进行零射成像到实际的传输: 在五个现实世界的任务中,从一个人类视频中学习到的政策在输入视频中未显示的配置上取得了75%的成功,超过了下一个最佳基线的71个百分点。
blocks.en: Trained entirely in simulation, the resulting policy completes the demonstrated task zero-shot on a real multi-fingered hand across initial and goal object poses not shown in the video. We evaluate five tasks spanning direct object manipulation and tool use on a UR3 arm with a 20-DoF Wuji 1 hand. On configurations with initial and goal poses not shown in the video, Dex-One2Many achieves a 60–85% real-world success rate, while the baselines remain at or below 15%. Our main contributions are as follows: • Stage-Wise Scene Graph Abstraction: We represent a human demonstration as a stage-wise scene graph that retains task-defining structure—the required hand–object and object–object relations and their ordering—while discarding execution-specific motion. • Scene-Graph-Grounded RL: We use each stage’s scene graph to generate diverse reset states through the task, enabling the policy to explore alternative grasps and motions while grounding its observations and rewards from the graph. • Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on unseen configurations: Across five real-world tasks, policies learned from a single human video achieve 75% mean success on configurations not shown in the input video, exceeding the next-best baseline by 71 percentage points.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作
blocks.en: 2 Related Work

blocks.zh: 概括一个人类录像中显示的处刑政策之外, 我们在附录A中审查了这两个方面最密切的工作以及更广泛的相关工作。
blocks.en: Generalizing dexterous policies beyond the execution shown in a single human video raises two key challenges identified in the introduction: task abstraction and hard exploration . We review the closest work in these two directions, along with broader related work, in Appendix A .

blocks.zh:
任务结构 从人类视频提取。 人类的视频被用于学习可重复使用的视觉表现(Nair等人,2022年;Lee等人,2026年c),奖励(Ma等人,2023年;Kumar等人,2022年;Huang等人,2024年a),定点轨迹(Bharadhwaj等人,2024年),潜伏计划(Wang等人,2023年a),或动作前传(Shaw等人,2022年)从大型视频收集. 然而,在单视频设定中,概括主要取决于视频是如何抽象的. 之前的工作将视频归纳为键点,键框,以物体为中心的图表,或物体摆出轨迹,然后通过摇摆或跟踪,或通过对周围的仿真数据进行合成,使所显示的处决适应新场景(Gao等人,2023年,Sieb等人,2020年,Hepert等人,2024年,Zhu等人,2024年,Li等人,2024年,周等人,2025年,Tang等人,2025年,Hepert等人,2026年). 因为转移是被证明的运动,适应只能延伸到可以重塑的运动。 关系任务规格提供了比较抽象的替代方案,并在符号和场景图规划中得到了很好的确立(Fikes and Nilsson, 1971, Rana et al., 2023),视觉语言模型从一部人类视频中提取了象征性的任务计划(Wake et al., 2024),从语言中提取了阶段性关系限制(Huang et al., 2024b). 基于这种关系观点,我们Stage-Wise Scene Graph抽象化从单一视频中提取任务结构,同时丢弃执行细节,将每个阶段编码为一个图形,其边缘是上游,说明手-对象和对象-对象关系必须持有哪个,按照视频显示的顺序排列. 与ORION的图表(Zhu et al., 2024)不同,我们的舞台场景图没有从视频中标注坐标或键点轨迹,因此每个图都描述的不是一个状态,而是满足其上游的一组状态. 而不是执行计划、调整参考物或优化成本,每个图表都是一种制约,抽样培训的国家必须满足,留下物体姿势、目标姿势,并自由掌握变化。
RL之后学习手的动作,而不是继承显示的运动.
blocks.en:
Task Structure Extraction from Human Videos. Human videos have been used to learn reusable visual representations ( Nair et al., 2022 , Lee et al., 2026c ) , rewards ( Ma et al., 2023 , Kumar et al., 2022 , Huang et al., 2024a ) , point tracks ( Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) , latent plans ( Wang et al., 2023a ) , or action priors ( Shaw et al., 2022 ) from large video collections. In the single-video setting, however, generalization depends largely on how the video is abstracted. Prior work abstracts the video into keypoints, keyframes, object-centric graphs, or object pose trajectories, then adapts the demonstrated execution to a new scene by warping or tracking it, or by synthesizing imitation data around it ( Gao et al., 2023 , Sieb et al., 2020 , Heppert et al., 2024 , Zhu et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2024 , Zhou et al., 2025 , Tang et al., 2025 , Heppert et al., 2026 ) . Because what transfers is the demonstrated motion, adaptation extends only as far as that motion can be reshaped. Relational task specifications provide a more abstract alternative and are well established in symbolic and scene-graph planning ( Fikes and Nilsson, 1971 , Rana et al., 2023 ) , and vision-language models have extracted symbolic task plans from a human video ( Wake et al., 2024 ) and stage-wise relational constraints from language ( Huang et al., 2024b ) . Building on this relational view, our Stage-Wise Scene Graph Abstraction extracts task structure from the single video, while discarding execution details, encoding each stage as a graph whose edges are predicates stating which hand–object and object–object relations must hold, in the order the video shows. Unlike ORION’s graphs ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , our stage-wise scene graph carries no coordinates or keypoint trajectories from the video, so each graph describes not one state but the set of all states that satisfy its predicates. Rather than a plan to execute, a reference to adapt, or a cost to optimize, each graph serves as a constraint that sampled training states must satisfy, leaving object poses, goal poses, and grasps free to vary.
RL then learns how the hand acts instead of inheriting the demonstrated motion.

blocks.zh: 学习Dexterous Manipulation 从一个单一人类视频。 Dexterous操纵给RL带来了一个艰难的探索问题,因为多指手势必须通过接触丰富的相互作用来协调许多关节(Rajeswaran等人,2018年). 因此,以往从人类视频中学习非曲直操控的方法可以提取执行层面的指引,如用作追踪奖励的物体外形轨迹(Lum等人,2025年,Zhu等人,2026年,Sharma等人,2026年,Chen等人,2025年b年,Mandi等人,2026年b年),用作模仿或精炼参考的重定向手动(秦等人,2022年;李等人,2025年;Pan等人,2025年;Paliwal等人,2026年;Han等人,2026年;Guzey等人,2025年),或显示接触。 (朱等人,2026年;夏尔马等人,2026年). 这种指导使探索具有可引导性,但将由此产生的行为与已显示的运动联系起来,即使另一个初始物体摆出,目标摆出,或抓取需要不同执行同一任务. 因此,它们的概括性主要局限于围绕演示配置的局部变化(Lum等人,2025年,Han等人,2026年,Zhu等人,2026年). 1 1 1 Human2Sim2 机器人:在4cm×\time 4cm,固定进球内初始位置; Video2Sim2 Real:在 ±\pm 5cm, ± 10\\pm 10\circ}内初始/目标. 然而,取消执行层面的指导,造成了第二个挑战:如何使仅从任务结构中就有效开展研究。 基于重置的RL通过在已知目标(Florensa et al., 2017)附近或沿着演示(Resnick et al., 2018, Salimans and Chen, 2018, Tao et al., 2024, Bauza et al., 2025)开始事件来缓解艰难探索,因此政策在到达它们之前先从后来的州学习. 然而,基于演示的重置继承了演示处决。 更近一些的方法,如OmniReset(Yin等人,2026年)和Video2Policy(Ye等人,2025年),通过生成重置状态或任务程序来减少这种依赖性,但依赖于用户指定的任务信息或视频衍生对象状态,并且仅通过平行抓捕器进行演示. 我们的方法在从人类视频中衍生出来的阶段性场景图中基于重现、观察和奖励,从而得出任务结构,而不模仿执行。
blocks.en: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Video. Dexterous manipulation poses a hard exploration problem for RL because multi-fingered hands must coordinate many joints through contact-rich interactions ( Rajeswaran et al., 2018 ) . Prior methods that learn dexterous manipulation from human video therefore extract execution-level guidance, such as object pose trajectories used as a tracking reward ( Lum et al., 2025 , Zhu et al., 2026 , Sharma et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2025b , Mandi et al., 2026 ) , retargeted hand motions used as references to imitate or refine ( Qin et al., 2022 , Li et al., 2025 , Pan et al., 2025 , Paliwal et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 , Guzey et al., 2025 ) , or demonstrated contacts ( Zhu et al., 2026 , Sharma et al., 2026 ) . This guidance makes exploration tractable but ties the resulting behavior to the demonstrated motion, even when another initial object pose, goal pose, or grasp requires a different execution of the same task. As a result, their generalization is largely limited to local variations around the demonstrated configuration ( Lum et al., 2025 , Han et al., 2026 , Zhu et al., 2026 ) . 1 1 1 Human2Sim2Robot: initial position within 4 cm × \times 4 cm, fixed goal; Video2Sim2Real: initial/goal within ± \pm 5 cm, ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} . Removing execution-level guidance, however, creates the second challenge: how to make RL explore efficiently from task structure alone. Reset-based RL alleviates hard exploration by starting episodes near a known goal ( Florensa et al., 2017 ) or along a demonstration ( Resnick et al., 2018 , Salimans and Chen, 2018 , Tao et al., 2024 , Bauza et al., 2025 ) , so the policy learns from later states before it can reach them. Demonstration-based resets, however, inherit the demonstrated execution. More recent approaches such as OmniReset ( Yin et al., 2026 ) and Video2Policy ( Ye et al., 2025 ) reduce this dependence by generating reset states or task programs, but rely on user-specified task information or video-derived object states and have only been demonstrated with parallel-jaw grippers. Our approach grounds resets, observations, and rewards in a stage-wise scene graph derived from the human video, so it derives the task structure without imitating the execution.

blocks.zh: 图2:Dex-One2Many概况. (1)从一个单一的人类视频中,一个VLM提取出一个阶段性的场景图形,显示物体关系. (2)每个阶段图限制物体的取样姿势和合成抓取,产生每个阶段经过核实的重置状态. 通过一个QP控制器,从这些软件中培训出一项RL政策,在任务空间中进行上游奖励行为。 (3) 政策将零射入未见的初始阵容、目标并掌握真正的硬件。
blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of Dex-One2Many. (1) From a single human video, a VLM extracts a stage-wise scene graph of object relations. (2) Each stage graph constrains the sampling of object poses and synthesized grasps, yielding verified reset states for every stage. An RL policy trained from these resets with predicate-derived rewards acts in task space through a QP controller. (3) The policy transfers zero-shot to unseen initial poses, goal poses, and grasps on real hardware.

blocks.zh: 3 方法
blocks.en: 3 Method

blocks.zh:
考虑到一个单一的操纵任务,我们的目标是学习一个非曲直的政策,将它概括到不同的空间配置,包括随机化的物体姿势和新颖的抓住,超越原始的视频. 为了实现这一目标,我们首先将演示抽象成一个阶段性的场景图(Sec. 3.1)。
然后,我们制定政策学习,作为基于此图的马可夫决策进程(MDP),其中包含观察,奖励,以及从中构建的初始状态分布,而不包含特定任务的设计(第3.2条)。 所学政策随后将零射入真机器人(第3.3节). 图2概述了整个管道。
blocks.en:
Given a single demonstration of a manipulation task, our goal is to learn a dexterous policy that generalizes to diverse spatial configurations, including randomized object poses and novel grasps, beyond the original video. To achieve this, we first abstract the demonstration into a stage-wise scene graph (Sec. 3.1 ).
We then formulate policy learning as a Markov decision process (MDP) grounded in this graph, with observations, rewards, and an initial-state distribution constructed from it without task-specific design (Sec. 3.2 ). The learned policy then transfers zero-shot to the real robot (Sec. 3.3 ). Fig. 2 summarizes the full pipeline.

blocks.zh: 3.1 任务摘要作为阶段图像
blocks.en: 3.1 Task Abstraction as a Stage-wise Scene Graph

blocks.zh: 我们把人类的视频抽象为一系列的舞台场景图, 来保存关系必须维持的顺序, 同时让物体的姿势, 目标, 姿势, 抓住, 和轨迹变化。 每个图代表任务的一个阶段:其节点识别手,任务相关对象及其功能部分,而其边缘则描述该阶段的特征关系. 当不同配置执行相同任务时,姿势和轨迹可能有所不同,但所需关系及其顺序保持不变. 我们把这个抽象称为“舞台-智慧场景图抽象”。
blocks.en: We abstract the human video as a sequence of stage-wise scene graphs that preserve which relations must hold and in what order, while allowing object poses, goal poses, grasps, and trajectories to vary. Each graph represents one stage of the task: its nodes identify the hand, task-relevant objects, and their functional parts, while its edges describe the relations characterizing that stage. When the same task is performed from different configurations, the poses and trajectories may differ, but the required relations and their order remain the same. We refer to this abstraction as Stage-Wise Scene Graph Abstraction .

blocks.zh: 为了编码场景图边缘所携带的关系,而不固定视频中观察到的姿势,我们使用预先定义的,任务独立的上游词汇(表3). 有些上游指定了必须持有的关系,如抓取,接触,以及内部的关系,而另一些则描述接近下一个将要建立的关系,如pre_grasp和pre_inide. 前者说明现阶段必须持有什么,后者则说明下一步应建立何种关系。 这些上游部分一起描述了任务进度,而没有固定视频中显示的具体配置.
blocks.en: To encode the relations carried by the scene-graph edges without fixing the poses observed in the video, we use a predefined, task-independent predicate vocabulary (Table 3 ). Some predicates specify relations that must hold, such as grasp , contact , and inside , while others describe proximity toward the next relation to be established, such as pre_grasp and pre_inside . The former describe what must hold in the current stage, whereas the latter indicate which relation should be established next. Together, these predicates describe task progression without fixing the specific configuration shown in the video.

blocks.zh: 我们利用直接总结任务的视觉语言模型(VLM)从视频中恢复这些阶段性图表。 鉴于视频和上游词汇,VLM确定与任务相关的实体和功能部分为图表节点,并推断它们之间随着时间的推移的上游关系. 当上游关系发生变化时,我们引入一个新的阶段,要么是因为增加了新的关系,要么是因为正在处理的关系已经确立,例如,在过渡前到抓住时。 这会产生一个命令序列 G 1 : K = (G 1,..., G K )\ mathcal{G}_{1 : K}=(\mathcal{G}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{G}_{K}) 。 图2. 图2说明舞台场景图如何在粗略的任务中捕捉任务进展:在前-后阶段开始抓取时引入一个新的阶段;在后阶段,既定的抓取和接触关系仍然是制约,而玩具猫则移动到灰尘盆,直到建立新的内在关系。
blocks.en: We recover these stage-wise graphs from the video using a vision-language model (VLM) that abstracts the task directly. Given the video and the predicate vocabulary, the VLM identifies task-relevant entities and functional parts as graph nodes and infers the predicate relations between them over time. We introduce a new stage whenever the predicate relations change, either because a new relation is added or because a relation being approached becomes established, such as pre_grasp transitioning to grasp . This yields an ordered sequence 𝒢 1 : K = ( 𝒢 1 , … , 𝒢 K ) \mathcal{G}_{1:K}=(\mathcal{G}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{G}_{K}) . Fig. 2 illustrates how the stage-wise scene graph captures task progression in the sweeping task: a new stage is introduced when pre_grasp becomes grasp ; in later stages, the established grasp and contact relations remain as constraints, while the toy cat is moved toward the dustpan until the new inside relation is established.

blocks.zh: 3.2 场景图 强化学习
blocks.en: 3.2 Scene-graph-grounded Reinforcement Learning

blocks.zh: 考虑到场景的顺序 G 1 : K\ mathcal{G}_{1 :K} 来自第3.1 Sec. 3.1 , 我们制定政策学习, 作为有限范围 MDP M = Q⟨ S, A, p, r, γ, ^ 0, T\ mathcal{M}=\langle\ mathcal{S},\ mathcal{A}, p,r,\gamma,\rho_{0}, T\rrangle 。 这里,γ\gamma和T表示折扣因子和插座视野;模拟器提供过渡动态p ,A\mathcal{A}由一个低级QP控制器(3.3sec. 场景图定义了来自 S\ mathcal{S} 的政策观察 o, 奖励 r r , 和初始状态分布 ^ 0\rho\\0}, 如下所述 。
blocks.en: Given the scene-graph sequence 𝒢 1 : K \mathcal{G}_{1:K} from Sec. 3.1 , we formulate policy learning as a finite-horizon MDP ℳ = ⟨ 𝒮 , 𝒜 , p , r , γ , ρ 0 , T ⟩ \mathcal{M}=\langle\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},p,r,\gamma,\rho_{0},T\rangle . Here, γ \gamma and T T denote the discount factor and episode horizon; the simulator provides transition dynamics p p , and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} consists of desired palm and fingertip velocities tracked by a low-level QP controller (Sec. 3.3 ). The scene graph defines the policy observation o o from 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , the reward r r , and the initial-state distribution ρ 0 \rho_{0} , as described below.

blocks.zh:
现场图上的观察 我们从与任务相关的状态构建与场景图的节点和边缘相关的政策观测 O 。
节点以角色为代表: 手节点提供机器人自控,对象节点编码对象几何和6D的姿势,功能部分节点将抓取区域等区域本地化. 边缘捕捉连接实体之间的相对6D姿势. 由于这些编码是跨任务共享的,同样的观测构造适用于不同的任务图. 将这些节点和边缘特征组合起来构成政策观察,使观察设计可以重复使用(详见附录C.1)。
blocks.en:
Observation from the scene graph. We construct the policy observation o o from the task-relevant state associated with the scene graph’s nodes and edges.
Nodes are represented by role: the hand node provides robot proprioception, object nodes encode object geometry and 6D pose, and functional-part nodes localize regions such as the grasp region. Edges capture the relative 6D pose between connected entities. Because these encodings are shared across tasks, the same observation construction applies to different task graphs. Concatenating these node and edge features forms the policy observation, making the observation design reusable (see Appendix C.1 for details).

blocks.zh: 现场图中的任务奖励 。 每个场景图边缘编码两个实体之间的一个上游,我们将其映射为几何或物理奖励. 几何上游使用表3中的距离度量作为密集进度信号,用于空间关系的3D笛卡尔距离(例如,用于前-grasp的捕捉区域或用于前-内侧的可接受区域;图3(a)),以及用于座椅的联-空距. 对于非自然以这种距离为代表的上游,我们采用上游特定物理措施。 具体地说,我们用CHORD在6D扳手空间(Zhu等人,2026年)的强制关闭奖励来评估抓取,并辅之以抓取质量措施(Lynch and Park, 2017年)以确保抓取稳定性(详情和讨论见附录C.2)。
blocks.en: Task reward from the scene graph. Each scene-graph edge encodes a predicate between two entities, which we map to a geometric or physical reward. Geometric predicates use the distance metric in Table 3 as a dense progress signal, a 3D Cartesian distance for spatial relations (e.g., to a grasp region for pre_grasp or a receptive region for pre_inside ; Fig. 3 (a)) and a joint-space distance for seat . For predicates not naturally represented by such a distance, we use a predicate-specific physical measure. Specifically, we evaluate grasp using CHORD’s force-closure reward in 6D wrench space ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , augmented with a grasp-quality measure ( Lynch and Park, 2017 ) to ensure grasp stability (see Appendix C.2 for details and discussion).

blocks.zh:
我们从舞台图中构建任务奖励。 随着任务进入一个新阶段,对新引入的上游的奖励被添加到任务奖励中(图3(b))。
因为每个上游都有固定的奖励定义,所以我们在不同的任务中应用同样的构造. 图3(c)显示了这种用于直接和工具使用操纵任务的共享构建:虽然它们涉及不同的实体和上游序列,但它们的任务奖励来自相同的上游级奖励功能。
blocks.en:
With a reward defined for each predicate, we construct the task reward from the stage-wise scene graph. As the task progresses to a new stage, the reward for the newly introduced predicate is added to the task reward (Fig. 3 (b)).
Because each predicate has a fixed reward definition, we apply the same construction across different tasks. Fig. 3 (c) shows this shared construction for direct and tool-use manipulation tasks: although they involve different entities and predicate sequences, their task rewards are assembled from the same predicate-level reward functions.

blocks.zh:
从舞台角度的场景图表开始的状态分布. 虽然上游奖励指导着一个国家的进步,但分阶段场景图通过确定政策在培训期间可以执行的任务的哪些部分来定义初始状态分布.
由于每个阶段的图表 Gk \ mathcal{G}_{k} 修补关系, 但不提出或抓住关系, 我们用它作为基因约束来构建 ^ 0\rho_{0} 。
对于几何上游,提供密集进度信号的同一特征距离也作为放置规则:我们定位源节点相对于其目标节点,使表3中的条件维持,沿Gk\mathcal{G}_{k}(图10,附录C.3)的边缘应用这些规则.
对于最后阶段,我们首先对一个能满足目标上游状态的状态进行抽样,然后将其搅拌成接近目标状态,因为一个已经成功的重置提供了不太有用的学习信号。
编年史从这种重排开始,贯穿各个阶段,因此政策实践迟缓互动,而从任务开始就未首先接触它们,这减轻了长距离任务的勘探负担(Yin等人,2026年).
blocks.en:
Initial-state distribution from the stage-wise scene graphs. While predicate rewards guide progress from a state, the stage-wise scene graph defines the initial-state distribution by determining which parts of the task the policy can practice during training.
Since each stage graph 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} fixes relations but not poses or grasps, we construct ρ 0 \rho_{0} by using it as a generative constraint.
For geometric predicates, the same feature distance that provides their dense progress signal also serves as a placement rule: we position the source node relative to its target node so that the condition in Table 3 holds, applying these rules along the edges of 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} (Fig. 10 , Appendix C.3 ).
For the final stage, we first sample a state that satisfies the goal predicate and then perturb it into a near-goal state, since an already successful reset provides less useful learning signal.
Episodes start uniformly from such resets across all stages, so the policy practices late interactions without first reaching them from the task start, which reduces the exploration burden of long-horizon tasks ( Yin et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.zh:
为了把握,放置规则是把握综合. 我们不但没有固定一个控制器,反而把手放在Dexonomy(Chen等人,2025年a)产生的许多多指控制器中。 因此,这项政策在培训期间遇到不同的手-对象配置(附录C.3.2)。
每个抓图还包括手指命令 q cmd q_{\mathrm{cmd}}} 关闭对象上的手, 我们在初始化时恢复它,这样抓图就从第一步开始。
在采样状态进入 ^ 0\rho_{0} 之前, 我们在模拟中即时化它, 并且只有在它通过我们关于场景碰撞和重设稳定性的检查时才保留它, 使用事先在外部力量下认证的抓获( Appendix C.3.3 ) 。
blocks.en:
For grasp , the placement rule is grasp synthesis. Instead of fixing a single grasp, we place the hand at one of many multi-finger grasps generated by Dexonomy ( Chen et al., 2025a ) within the object’s grasp region. The policy thus encounters diverse hand–object configurations during training(Appendix C.3.2 ).
Each grasp also includes the finger command q cmd q_{\mathrm{cmd}} that closes the hand on the object, which we restore at initialization so the grasp holds from the first step.
Before a sampled state enters ρ 0 \rho_{0} , we instantiate it in simulation and keep it only if it passes our checks for scene collision and reset stability, using grasps certified beforehand under external forces (Appendix C.3.3 ).

blocks.zh: 3.3 零射Sim-to-Real 传输
blocks.en: 3.3 Zero-shot Sim-to-Real Transfer

blocks.zh:
我们用PPO(Schulman等人,2017年)来训练政策,使用非对称演员–批评(Pinto等人,2018年),其中批评者获得特权观察,演员只获得真实机器人上可用的场景图基观测. 为了实现零射转接,我们在训练期间随机抽取物体质量和摩擦等物理属性(附录C.5),并解决感知和控制中的sim-to-real差距.
在感知方面,我们在训练期间用物体的噪声,感知大小的噪声,以及观察延迟来干扰演员的观察. 在部署时,我们使用FoundationPose++来估计两台RGB-D相机的物体姿势 (Yan和Chu, 2025年),并将估算值与深度一致性加权值结合,以降低重量的不可靠视图(附录D).
在控制方面,政策产出需要手掌和指尖速度,一个QP低级控制员(Lee等人,2026年a)将手掌和指尖速度映射到联合速度,同时执行运动和部署时的安全限制。
这使得我们可以调整联合速度限制,并在部署时增加避免碰撞的限制,而不对政策进行再培训。 附录C.4提供了QP控制器的进一步细节,并展示了QP限制所防止的真世界硬件故障.
blocks.en:
We train the policy with PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) using an asymmetric actor–critic ( Pinto et al., 2018 ) , in which the critic receives privileged observations and the actor receives only the scene-graph-grounded observation available on the real robot. To enable zero-shot transfer, we randomize physical properties such as object mass and friction during training (Appendix C.5 ) and address the sim-to-real gap in perception and control.
On the perception side, we perturb the actor observations during training with object-pose noise, perceived-size noise, and observation delay. At deployment, we estimate object poses from two RGB-D cameras using FoundationPose++ ( Yan and Chu, 2025 ) and fuse the estimates with depth-consistency weights that down-weight unreliable views (Appendix D ).
On the control side, the policy outputs desired palm and fingertip velocities, which a QP low-level controller ( Lee et al., 2026a ) maps to joint velocities while enforcing kinematic and deployment-time safety constraints.
This lets us adjust joint-velocity limits and add collision-avoidance constraints at deployment without retraining the policy. Appendix C.4 provides further details on the QP controller and demonstrates a real-world hardware failure prevented by the QP constraints.

blocks.zh: 4 实验
blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价Dex-One2Many在模拟和真实硬件上. 我们的实验涉及三个问题:(问题1) Dex-One2Many是否将初始和目标配置概括到单人视频中没有显示的? (问题2)Dex - One2 许多人在各种有不同动静的表征中应用? (Q3)Dex-One2Many的哪些设计选择对其性能至关重要?
blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate Dex-One2Many in simulation and on real hardware. Our experiments address three questions: (Q1) Does Dex-One2Many generalize to initial and goal configurations not shown in the single human video? (Q2) Does Dex-One2Many apply across diverse dexterous embodiments with different kinematics? (Q3) Which design choices of Dex-One2Many are critical to its performance?

blocks.zh: Dex - One2 是否为 许多概括到没有在单人视频中显示的初始和目标配置?
blocks.en: Does Dex-One2Many generalize to initial and goal configurations not shown in the single human video?

blocks.zh: Dex - One2 是否为 许多人在各种有不同动静的表征中应用?
blocks.en: Does Dex-One2Many apply across diverse dexterous embodiments with different kinematics?

blocks.zh: Dex-One2Many的哪些设计选择对其性能至关重要?
blocks.en: Which design choices of Dex-One2Many are critical to its performance?

blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置
blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.zh: 任务 我们评价Dex-One2Many的五项操纵任务,这些任务涵盖直接对象操纵和工具使用(图4). 直接操纵任务(Doll, Can, Stamp)要求机器人抓住一个对象并将其移动到目标配置,而工具使用任务(Hammer,Sweep)则要求机器人抓住并操纵一个工具与另一个对象互动.
blocks.en: Tasks. We evaluate Dex-One2Many on five manipulation tasks that span direct object manipulation and tool use (Fig. 4 ). The direct-manipulation tasks (Doll, Can, Stamp) require the robot to grasp an object and move it to a target configuration, while the tool-use tasks (Hammer, Sweep) require the robot to grasp and manipulate a tool to interact with another object.

blocks.zh: 硬件设置. 我们用一个装有20-DoF Wuji 1 dexterous手的6-DoF UR3机器人臂进行所有真实世界的实验. 两台Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D相机从互补的角度捕捉工作空间. 我们使用 Foundation Pose++ 估计这些观测结果中的对象 (燕与楚,2025).
blocks.en: Hardware Setup. We conduct all real-world experiments on a 6-DoF UR3 robot arm equipped with a 20-DoF Wuji 1 dexterous hand. Two Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D cameras capture the workspace from complementary viewpoints. We estimate object poses from these observations using FoundationPose++ ( Yan and Chu, 2025 ) .

blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较一下我们的Dex -One2Many 和以前两种从单一的人类视频中 学得狡猾操纵的方法。 这些方法在从人类的演示中提取哪些信息以及如何将其用于政策学习方面各不相同.
如我所为(Paliwal等人,2026年)重建4D手 - 对象相互作用,通过轨迹优化将恢复的人类手动重新瞄准机器人。
CHORD(Zhu et al.,2026年)将演示对象状态演化作为模仿奖励,并用接触扳手指导加以增强,鼓励机器人复制演示的轨迹.
blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare our Dex-One2Many against two prior methods that learn dexterous manipulation from a single human video. These methods differ in what information they extract from the human demonstration and how they use it for policy learning.
Do as I Do ( Paliwal et al., 2026 ) reconstructs the 4D hand–object interaction and retargets the recovered human hand motion to the robot through trajectory optimization.
CHORD ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) uses the demonstrated object-state evolution as an imitation reward and augments it with contact-wrench guidance that encourages the robot to reproduce the demonstrated trajectories.

blocks.zh: 4.2 Dex - One2 Many 通用软件 超越人类视频?
blocks.en: 4.2 Does Dex-One2Many Generalize Beyond the Human Video?

blocks.zh: 图4:模拟与现实世界中超越人类视频的泛化. 报告在输入人类视频(见,上)中显示的配置成功率,在视频(见,下),模拟和真实世界中,初始和目标不同的配置未显示. 下行显示5项评估任务;N/A表示由于硬件故障而无法进行的实验.
blocks.en: Figure 4 : Generalization beyond the human video in simulation and the real world. Success rates are reported for configurations shown in the input human video ( Seen , top) and configurations with different initial and goal poses not shown in the video ( Unseen , bottom), in both simulation and the real world. The bottom row illustrates the five evaluated tasks; N/A denotes an experiment unavailable due to a hardware failure.

blocks.zh:
评价协议。 我们使用相同的Seen / Unseen 协议来评价模拟和现实世界中的概括化. 对于每一种方法和任务,我们都会在模拟中评价30集,对真正的机器人进行30次试验:在Seen配置中评价10集,在Unseen配置中评价20集.
Seenn配置复制了输入人类视频中显示的初始和目标姿势,而Unseen配置则使用不同的初始和目标姿势在视频中没有出现. 所有评价事件都从空手开始,要求政策执行从到达到任务完成的全部任务. 我们部署现实世界的政策是零点的,没有现实世界的数据或微调。
blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. We evaluate generalization in both simulation and the real world using the same Seen / Unseen protocol. For each method and task, we evaluate 30 episodes in simulation and 30 trials on the real robot: 10 in Seen configurations and 20 in Unseen configurations.
The Seen configurations reproduce the initial and goal poses shown in the input human video, whereas the Unseen configurations use different initial and goal poses not present in the video. All evaluation episodes start with an empty hand and require the policy to execute the full task from reaching to task completion. We deploy real-world policies zero-shot, without real-world data or fine-tuning.

blocks.zh:
结果。 图4比较了模拟和现实世界中Seen和Unseen配置上的性能. 在Seen配置上,基线可以在几个任务上取得很高的成功,表明从人类视频中提取的执行级指导可以复制已显示的任务配置.
差异在Unseen配置上变得明显. 在整个评估的基线中,模拟和现实世界的成功率都保持在15%或以下,而Dex-One2Many在模拟和真正的机器人上的成功率分别为85-100%和60-85%。
blocks.en:
Results. Figure 4 compares performance on Seen and Unseen configurations in simulation and the real world. On Seen configurations, the baselines can achieve high success on several tasks, showing that execution-level guidance extracted from the human video can reproduce the demonstrated task configuration.
The difference becomes pronounced on Unseen configurations. Across the evaluated baselines, success remains at or below 15% in both simulation and the real world, whereas Dex-One2Many achieves 85–100% success in simulation and 60–85% on the real robot.

This shows that the performance gap is not limited to a particular set of evaluation configurations, but reflects broader spatial generalization beyond the demonstrated execution. In contrast, Dex-One2Many uses stage-wise scene graphs as generative constraints for diverse task-consistent training states, allowing the policy to learn the same task structure across different configurations beyond the demonstrated execution.

结果。 表1按任务分列成功率和五个任务的平均值,分别用于四个明显的明显表现。 尽管在手动运动方面有重大差异,但Dex-One2Many在所有四个测试中都取得了一贯的高性能,平均成功率从94.6%到96.8%不等。 附录E.3列出了所有五项任务和多种配置。 图6还表明,所学的处决是具体表现的。 在同一任务规格下,不同的手会采用不同的抓取类型,同样的手会随着对象配置的变化而改变它的抓取.
Dex-One2Many没有重新瞄准一个固定的人类抓获,而是将RL暴露在为每个形态学合成的多种抓获中,而政策学则学习了抓住每个场景配置.

Results. Table 1 reports task-wise success rates and the mean across five tasks for four distinct dexterous embodiments. Despite substantial differences in arm–hand kinematics, Dex-One2Many achieves consistently high performance across all four tested embodiments, with mean success rates ranging from 94.6% to 96.8%. Appendix E.3 provides rollouts across all five tasks and multiple configurations. Figure 6 further shows that the learned execution is embodiment-specific. Under the same task specification, different hands adopt different grasp types, and the same hand can change its grasp as the object configuration changes.
Rather than retargeting a fixed human grasp, Dex-One2Many exposes RL to diverse grasps synthesized for each morphology, and the policy learns which grasp suits each scene configuration.
Appendix E.2 provides additional grasp examples across embodiments and configurations.

blocks.zh: 4.4 哪些设计选择对Dex-One2Many至关重要?
blocks.en: 4.4 Which Design Choices Are Critical to Dex-One2Many?

blocks.zh: 评价协议。 我们在模拟中进行关于扫荡任务的所有研究。 成功是从空手启动的完整任务集中衡量的. 我们研究了Dex-One2-Many的两个方面:其学习部分的贡献和培训规模的影响. 对于组件模拟,我们一次删除一个组件,同时保持所有其他培训设置不变。 就培训规模分析而言,我们只改变用于PPO培训的平行环境的数目。
blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. We conduct all ablation studies on the Sweep task in simulation. Success is measured on full-task episodes from empty-hand starts. We study two aspects of Dex-One2Many: the contribution of its learning components and the effect of training scale. For component ablations, we remove one component at a time while keeping all other training settings unchanged. For the training-scale analysis, we vary only the number of parallel environments used for PPO training.

blocks.zh:
组件堆积。 从人类的视频中,Dex-One2Many提取出一个阶段性的场景图,指定每个阶段的任务关系.
我们审查了如何利用这一任务结构进行政策学习的三个设计选择。 (1)移除阶段性重置(w/o阶段性重置)在2k PPO更新后,成功率从90%以上降至16%左右,表明从中间阶段开始是探索多阶段任务的关键. (2) 取消上游产生的奖励(w/o密集奖励),使整个培训的成功率保持在0%,表明对所需任务关系的密集反馈对于指导勘探至关重要。 (3)最后,省略已核实的关闭命令(w/o q cm d q cmd}),在2K PPO更新后,成功率降至约48%,并诱发频繁的抓取滑动和下降,表明恢复主动接触力对于跨阶段的稳定过渡至关重要.
blocks.en:
Component ablations. From the human video, Dex-One2Many extracts a stage-wise scene graph that specifies the task relations at each stage.
We examine three design choices in how this task structure is used for policy learning. (1) Removing stage-wise resets (w/o stage-wise reset) drops success after 2k PPO updates from over 90% to about 16%, showing that starting from intermediate stages is key to exploring multi-stage tasks. (2) Removing predicate-derived rewards (w/o dense reward) keeps the success rate at 0% throughout training, showing that dense feedback toward the required task relations is critical for guiding exploration. (3) Finally, omitting the verified closing command (w/o q c ​ m ​ d q_{cmd} ) lowers success to about 48% after 2K PPO updates and induces frequent grasp slips and drops, showing that restoring active contact forces is vital for stable transitions across stages.

blocks.zh: 培训规模的影响。 增加平行环境的数量可大大提高学习速度和最终业绩。 49,152 49{,} 152 环境, Dex- One2 许多人的成功率超过90%,而24 576 24{、}576或12 288 12{、} 288个环境的培训仍然低于25%的PPO更新数量。 这些结果表明,大规模平行的收集经验,对我们在多样化的重设分配下的政策学习大有助益。
blocks.en: Effect of training scale. Increasing the number of parallel environments substantially improves learning speed and final performance. With 49,152 49{,}152 environments, Dex-One2Many reaches over 90% success, whereas training with 24,576 24{,}576 or 12,288 12{,}288 environments remains below 25% within the same number of PPO updates. These results show that large-scale parallel experience collection substantially benefits policy learning under our diverse reset distribution.

blocks.zh: 5 结论
blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.zh:
我们提出了Dex-One2Many, 一个真实到真实的框架,用来从一个单一的人类视频中学习一般的可调性操纵。 Dex-One2Many没有将显示的动作当作执行参考,而是将视频归纳成一个阶段性的场景图,既保留任务结构,同时又留下物体的姿势,目标姿势,抓住,运动路径可以自由变化.
场景 然后,RL利用这种结构构建不同的相位重置状态和上游产生的奖励,使勘探可进行,而不继承已显示的轨迹。
在五个操纵任务中,由此产生的政策概括到视频中未显示的配置,并将零拍转到真正的多指手势中.
这些结果表明,从一个人类视频中提取必须实现的目标,同时让RL发现如何实现,提供了一个从单一演示到多样的狡猾行为的充满希望的路线.
blocks.en:
We presented Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework for learning generalizable dexterous manipulation from a single human video. Rather than treating the demonstrated motion as an execution reference, Dex-One2Many abstracts the video into a stage-wise scene graph that preserves the task structure while leaving object poses, goal poses, grasps, and motion paths free to vary.
Scene-Graph-Grounded RL then uses this structure to construct diverse stage-wise reset states and predicate-derived rewards, making exploration tractable without inheriting the demonstrated trajectory.
Across five manipulation tasks, the resulting policies generalize to configurations not shown in the video and transfer zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand.
These results suggest that extracting what must be achieved from a human video, while allowing RL to discover how to achieve it, provides a promising route from a single demonstration to diverse dexterous behaviors.

blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作。 虽然Dex-One2Many大大改进了全隐形构型的概括性,并适用于多种手型形态,但仍有一些局限性.
首先,由于现实世界的部署依赖于估计的6D物体的外形,所以还存在一个模拟到现实的差距. Pose-估测噪声和模拟物体几何学与真物体几何学的区别可以降低政策性能,特别是在接触丰富的相互作用中.
第二,我们的真到真输油管重建的只是刚性物体,所以拼接的物体需要人工建造的资产.
由于单一的视频可能无法显示基本的表达结构,例如联合地点、轴线和联合限制,因此自动的实景重建仍然困难重重。 从不受限制的视频中直接推断这些结构动能是未来工作的重要途径.
blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. Although Dex-One2Many substantially improves generalization across unseen configurations and applies to diverse hand morphologies, several limitations remain.
First, a sim-to-real gap remains because real-world deployment relies on estimated 6D object poses. Pose-estimation noise and differences between simulated and real object geometry can degrade policy performance, particularly during contact-rich interactions.
Second, our real-to-sim pipeline reconstructs only rigid objects, so articulated objects would require manually built assets.
Since a single video may not reveal the underlying articulation structure, such as joint locations, axes, and joint limits, automatic real-to-sim reconstruction remains difficult. Inferring these structural kinematics directly from unconstrained video is an important avenue for future work.

blocks.zh:
模拟中演示种子RL. 一条平行线通过在模拟中将演示获得的信息注入RL,使多阶段探索具有可推广性.
先前的方法将这一信息用作事前行动(Torne等人,2024年;Ankile等人,2025年),作为对象的进度目标(Dan等人,2025年),或生成和完善特定任务重设和奖励方案(Ye等人,2025年)。
在每一种情况下,示范指导探索,具体说明政策应如何行动、进展或得到奖励。
相反,我们利用演示来识别在阶段性场景图中编码的上层对象关系如何随时间变化.
这些变化定义了任务阶段,我们从这些阶段构建不同,物理上有效的重置状态,跨越所有中间阶段,包括合成的多指抓.
这些阶段性重置状态使得事件能够直接从任务的中间阶段开始,减轻勘探负担. 此外,将政策置于多重配置之下,导致政策更加笼统。 因此,录影带具体规定了政策必须实现的阶段关系及其时间顺序,而不是提供所显示的行动、运动目标或所遵循的奖励程序。
blocks.en:
Demonstration-seeded RL in simulation. A parallel line makes multi-stage exploration tractable by injecting demonstration-derived information into RL in simulation.
Prior methods use this information as an action prior ( Torne et al., 2024 , Ankile et al., 2025 ) , as object-pose progress targets ( Dan et al., 2025 ) , or to generate and refine task-specific reset and reward programs ( Ye et al., 2025 ) .
In each case, the demonstration guides exploration by specifying how the policy should act, progress, or be rewarded.
Instead, we use the demonstration to identify how object relations change at the predicate level encoded in the stage-wise scene graph over time.
These changes define the task stages, from which we construct diverse, physically valid reset states across all intermediate stages, including synthesized multi-finger grasps.
These stage-wise reset states allow episodes to start directly from intermediate stages of the task, reducing exploration burden. Furthermore, exposing the policy to multiple configurations results in a more generalizable policy. Thus, the video specifies the stage-wise relations the policy must achieve and their temporal order, rather than providing demonstrated actions, motion targets, or a reward program to follow.

blocks.zh:

把握和示威(徐等人,2023年;万万等人,2023年;袁等人,2026年;朴等人,2026年;张等人,2025年). 这些方法主要针对不同物体的强力获取,而我们的目标是解决全部操纵任务。 我们利用把握合成来产生不同的重置状态,并通过强化学习来训练政策,以获得把握,并随后实施操纵阶段.
blocks.en:
Task-Aware Grasp Synthesis and Learned Grasp Acquisition. TaskDexGrasp conditions static dexterous hand-pose synthesis on task semantics, while Dexterous Functional Grasping combines semantic affordances with a learned grasp-acquisition controller ( Chen et al., 2024 , Agarwal et al., 2023 ) . A broader line learns
generalizable grasp proposal, acquisition, or maintenance from synthetic
grasps and demonstrations ( Xu et al., 2023 , Wan et al., 2023 , Yuan et al., 2026 , Park et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2025 ) . These methods primarily target robust grasp acquisition across diverse objects, whereas our goal is to solve the full manipulation task. We use grasp synthesis to generate diverse reset states and train the policy via reinforcement learning to acquire the grasp and execute subsequent manipulation stages.

blocks.zh:
Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation. (原始内容存档于2019-09-27). 基于模拟的强化学习已成功应用到现实世界的 dexterous in hand 定向(Andrychowicz等人,2020年). 之后的工作将这种环境扩展到更快的控制(Handa等人,2023年),更方便的硬件和触觉反馈(Yang等人,2024年)。
最近的系统转向了较长范围的互动。 SimTooleReal(Kedia等人,2026年)通过跟踪从人类视频中提取的完整6D工具轨迹,执行将工具移动到目标姿势的政策,并隐蔽地执行任务. 由于在执行期间假设有这个目标姿势序列,而且我们的任务设定没有提供执行时的这种轨迹信息,因此这两个设置并不直接可比. Play2Perfect(Lum等人,2026年)和ADEPT(Lee等人,2026年b)转而专注于可重复使用的dexterous预训: Play2Perfect在对下游组装任务进行微调前先从任务不可知游戏中学习,而ADEPT则预留了通用对象重置技能,使其适应插入和放置. 这些方法补充了我们的方法,因为它们研究预训如何支持下游的操纵,而我们则专注于从单一的人类视频中学习新的任务.
blocks.en:
Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation. Simulation-based reinforcement learning has been successfully applied to real-world dexterous in-hand orientation ( Andrychowicz et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent work has extended this setting toward faster control ( Handa et al., 2023 ) , more accessible hardware, and tactile feedback ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
Recent systems move toward longer-horizon interaction. SimToolReal ( Kedia et al., 2026 ) trains a policy to move tools toward target poses and executes unseen tasks by tracking the full 6D tool trajectory extracted from a human video. Because this target pose sequence is assumed available during execution, and our task setting does not provide such trajectory information at execution time, the two settings are not directly comparable. Play2Perfect ( Lum et al., 2026 ) and ADEPT ( Lee et al., 2026b ) instead focus on reusable dexterous pretraining: Play2Perfect learns from task-agnostic play before fine-tuning on downstream assembly tasks, while ADEPT pretrains generic object-reposing skills and adapts them to insertion and placement. These approaches complement to ours, as they study how pretraining supports downstream manipulation, whereas we focus on learning a new task from a single human video.

blocks.zh: 强制关闭和质量目标。 强制关闭被广泛用于评价和合成稳定的多指抓. 近代方法提出了不同的强力封闭目标,以产生物理上稳定的横跨物体和手表的直径控制(刘等人,2021年;王等人,2023年b;Zurbrügg等人,2025年)。
blocks.en: Force Closure and Grasp-Quality Objectives. Force closure is widely used to evaluate and synthesize stable multi-finger grasps. Recent methods formulate differentiable force-closure objectives to generate physically stable dexterous grasps across objects and hand embodiments ( Liu et al., 2021 , Wang et al., 2023b , Zurbrügg et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.zh: 武力关闭措施也被用作强化学习奖励。 CHORD(Zhu et al., 2026)在示范衍生的接触指导不可靠时,对学习狡猾的操纵采用了强制关闭奖励. 我们采用这个 " 制止武力 " 一词,用最弱的定向抓住质量措施加以补充,以鼓励稳定掌握。 虽然同时进行的工作同样将抓取质量作为密集的奖励,以加强手头操纵时的弱扳手方向(Chen等人,2026年b),但我们却用最弱的抓取质量措施来增加查取力奖励,以获得稳定的抓取力,作为多阶段操纵任务的一部分。
blocks.en: Force-closure measures have also been used as reinforcement learning rewards. CHORD ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) introduces a force-closure reward for learning dexterous manipulation when demonstration-derived contact guidance is unreliable. We adopt this force-closure term by augmenting it with a weakest-direction grasp-quality measure to encourage stable grasps. While concurrent work similarly uses grasp quality as a dense reward to strengthen weak wrench directions during in-hand manipulation ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , we augment the force-closure reward with a weakest-direction grasp-quality measure to acquire stable grasps as part of a multi-stage manipulation task.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are analyzing a human demonstration video for robot learning ( real2sim ). The human hand in the video corresponds to a ROBOT END - EFFECTOR . Refer to it as " ee ". Do NOT list the hand as an object ; it is the agent , not a manipulable object . Extract , grounded ONLY in what is visually observable : 1. TASK : concise name and one - line description . 2. OBJECTS : the manipulable objects of interest ( NOT the hand ). For each : a short id , a category , a visual_phrase , and roles . category vs visual_phrase — these are DIFFERENT and both required : - " category ": the clean object class used to search an asset library (" kettle ", " mug ", " knife "). A superordinate is fine here . - " visual_phrase ": what you would type into an open - vocabulary SEGMENTATION model to select exactly this object in the video frame . 2-4 words , concrete and appearance - bearing : colour and / or material plus the specific noun (" red enamel kettle ", " white ceramic mug ", " wooden cutting board "). NEVER an abstract superordinate (" container ", " object ", " item ", " tool ") — those ground to nothing . If two objects in the frame share a noun , the phrase must be what tells them apart . Do NOT include the workspace surface itself ( worktable , desk , floor , walls ) — it is part of the robot cell , not an object . But DO include a fixed object that holds another object off that surface ( a knife holder , a dish rack , a tray ): it is not manipulated , yet the scene is wrong without it . Likewise include every object that another object is , or ends up , " seated " in ( inserted , driven , or screwed into it : the bottle a cork is pressed into , the socket a plug is pushed into ), even if the hand never touches it . roles — assign ALL that apply , judged from what visibly happens in the video : - " held ": the hand grasps and holds this object at some point ( both directly - placed objects and tools count ). - " site ": another object comes to rest ON or IN this object ( plate under food , cutting board , container receiving something ). - " acted_on ": a HELD object acts on this object through contact ( food being cut , dough being rolled , a window being wiped ). - " fixture ": this object is already holding another object up when the demo begins , and the hand never touches it ( a holder , a rack , a tray ). " site " and " fixture " differ in WHEN : a site receives an object as a result of the manipulation , a fixture is holding one before it starts . The plate a cake is placed on is a site ; the holder the knife rests in is a fixture . A pot that is carried and later receives food is [" held ", " site "]. Also determine per object : - " upright ": true if the object is normally stored / used standing upright ( cup , bottle , vase , jar → true ; plate , cutting board , spatula , knife → false ). - " grasping_part ": for " held " objects , the part the hand grasps . - " working_direction ": for " held " tool - use objects , how the working part moves against the target at the moment of contact — " down " if the tool is raised and brought down onto it ( pestle , potato masher , cookie cutter ), " horizontal " if the tool is pushed sideways across a surface ( squeegee , spatula , rolling pin ). This decides the contact pose the sampler builds ; getting it wrong produces a tool that slides sideways when it should come down . null if not tool - use . - " working_part ": for " held " objects that physically contact another object to do work ( tool - use ), the functional surface that does the work . null if the held object is placed directly ( not tool - use ). PART NAMING — these two strings are fed verbatim to an open - vocabulary segmenter as text prompts . Name the SMALLEST region that actually carries the part ’ s role , and describe ONLY that region . Write "< attribute > < part > of the < object >" with EXACTLY ONE attribute , and that attribute must belong to the region you are naming — not to anything attached to it . If the handle is the part , describe the handle alone : its own colour , its own material . Say nothing about the head , the shaft , the body , or the object ’ s overall look , even when those features are the most obvious thing in the demo . Every word describing a neighbouring region is an invitation for the mask to spread into that region . Keep the < object > slot bare — the plain object noun , never " the red mug " or " the wooden - handled knife ". NEVER enumerate . If the region itself shows two colours , pick the one that covers most of it — do not write both . A colour the region shares with a neighbouring region is fine : name the region as it actually looks . Never borrow a colour from an adjacent part just to stand apart from it . good : " blue handle of the screwdriver " ( grip region only ) " black handle of the spatula " ( same black as the blade — still right , that is what it looks like ) " rubber blade of the squeegee " ( blade only , not the frame ) " metal blade of the knife " " black grip of the pan " bad : " handle " ( no attribute — bleeds outward ) " silver handle of the ladle " ( silver is the neck ; the grip the hand holds is black — a colour borrowed from the neighbour ) " black handle of the silver pan " ( attribute on the object — mask jumps to the body ) " wooden handle of the metal knife " ( describes the blade too ) " blue and red handle of the screwdriver " ( enumeration — matches the whole screwdriver ) " blue rubber ergonomic handle of the screwdriver " ( piled attributes ) Use only attributes actually visible in the demo ; never invent a colour . If no attribute applies to the region on its own , write just "< part > of the < object >". null if not applicable . 3. SCENE_GRAPH : express it with PREDICATES ONLY ( do not write free - form sentences ), in three parts : initial_state , goal_condition , stages . initial_state : what is already mounted on what in the FIRST frame , before the hand moves . Most demos start with everything simply lying on the table — in that case return an empty list . Emit an entry only when an object begins the demo ** held off the table by another object ** in a definite resting pose : a ladle hanging on its rack , a part seated in a tray , a bit sitting in a holder . The only predicate here is " fixed_to ": a is the object being held , b is the thing holding it . Nothing else — this list is not about what the hand does . - arg ’ a ’ must be an object that LATER MOVES ( it appears in the stages ). An object that never moves needs no entry : it is simply part of the scene . - arg ’ b ’ is the holder . Give it the " fixture " role in OBJECTS . - Do not describe an object resting directly on the table or the ground . - Do not describe a part that is already inserted , driven , or screwed into another object . That is a joint , not a mount , and it is not expressed here . goal_condition and stages — allowed predicates : { predicate_list }. - goal_condition : the set of predicates that must ALL hold at success ( goal state ). - stages : the relations that become established during the demo , one per entry , in the temporal order in which they are established . List only relations that become TRUE ; do NOT add entries for approaching , reaching , or moving toward something — approach phases are derived automatically from these relations . Use " ee " as arg ’ a ’ for grasp . Be precise about when each relation is actually established ( e . g . distinguish real contact from the tool merely hovering near the target ). AGENCY TRANSFER : when a source acts on a target through " grasp " or " contact ", the target becomes arg ’ a ’ of the subsequent stages — it is the thing that moves next , not the original actor . ( ee grasps spatula → spatula becomes arg ’ a ’; spatula contacts pancake → pancake becomes arg ’ a ’ for the move onto the plate .) Choose predicates from the list ; never invent new ones . - " inside " vs " seat ": use " seat " ONLY when the object ends up DRIVEN / PRESSED INTO the other one so the two become a single rigid assembly ( a cork pressed into a bottle , a plug pushed into a socket , a drawer pushed shut ). Use " inside " when the object merely ends up within an open container and could be lifted straight out ( fruit placed in a basket , an item dropped in a bin ). ( grasp -> grasp , contact -> contact , place -> on_top / inside / seat ). Do not hallucinate objects not present . blocks.en: We reconstruct each task-relevant object from the first frame of the demonstration; the full video is used only by the VLM query. blocks.zh: 图10:场景图约束重置生成. 考虑到阶段性的场景图和资产,我们即刻将每个任务阶段作为不同的重置状态。 对象和手资产提供几何学和物理属性,而功能部分节点识别区域如抓取和工作区域. 两者合在一起,用于构建一个抓取集,在具备时仅限于指定的抓取区域. 对于每个阶段,场景图中的上游都起到基因约束的作用:几何上游确定相关实体在哪里可以取样,而抓取上游样本则从抓取集中得出有效的手-对象配置. 重复这个过程会产生不同的模拟重置状态,满足每个阶段图指定的关系.
blocks.en: Figure 10 : Scene-graph-constrained reset generation. Given the stage-wise scene graph and the assets, we instantiate each task stage as diverse reset states. The object and hand assets provide geometry and physical properties, while functional part nodes identify regions such as grasp and working regions. Together, these are used to construct a grasp set, restricted to the specified grasp region when available. For each stage, predicates in the scene-graph act as generative constraints: geometric predicates determine where related entities can be sampled, while the grasp predicate samples a valid hand–object configuration from the grasp set. Repeating this process produces diverse simulation reset states that satisfy the relations specified by each stage graph.

blocks.zh:
本节详述了我们如何构建第3.2节的阶段性初始状态分布。 图10概述了这一进程。
每个阶段图 Gk \ mathcal{G}_{k} 指定哪些关系必须维持在任务的那个点, 但留下对象的姿势和抓取自由, 因此许多几何区分的状态满足了它 。 我们分两步产生这样的国家。 首先,我们抽样说明满足了阶段图的上游条件,将每个上游作为将一个节点相对另一个节点放置的规则(Sec.C.3.1);将抓取的上游从一组合成的dexterous抓取(Sec.C.3.2.)中即时化. 第二,我们只保留那些仍然可用于其余任务并在模拟中具有物理效力的状态(Sec.C.3.3.)。 每个阶段我们保留10 000个经核实的州,这构成其重置分配。 因此,由此产生的状态不是场景的随机配置,而是同一任务结构的不同即时设定.
blocks.en:
This section details how we construct the stage-wise initial-state distribution ρ 0 \rho_{0} of Sec. 3.2 . Fig. 10 summarizes the process.
Each stage graph 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} specifies which relations must hold at that point of the task but leaves object poses and grasps free, so many geometrically distinct states satisfy it. We generate such states in two steps. First, we sample states that satisfy the predicates of the stage graph, using each predicate as a rule for placing one node relative to another (Sec. C.3.1 ); the grasp predicate is instantiated from a set of synthesized dexterous grasps (Sec. C.3.2 ). Second, we keep only the states that remain usable for the rest of the task and are physically valid in simulation (Sec. C.3.3 ). We retain 10,000 verified states per stage, which form its reset distribution. The resulting states are therefore not random configurations of the scene, but diverse instantiations of the same task structure.

blocks.zh: 表3中的每个上游都以其两个节点的几何特征来定义,相同的特征决定一个节点相对于另一个节点可以放置在哪里. 例如,在_top上将源对象的底点限制在目标的支持补丁上,内部将源对象的根点限制在目标的内部框上. 我们使用这些条件作为放置规则:为了满足一个上游,我们在目标节点和上游定义的区域中取样其源节点的姿势.
blocks.en: Each predicate in Table 3 is defined on geometric features of its two nodes, and the same features determine where one node can be placed relative to the other. For example, on_top restricts the bottom point of the source object to the support patch of the target, and inside restricts the root point of the source object to the interior box of the target. We use these conditions as placement rules: to satisfy a predicate, we sample the pose of its source node within the region that its target node and the predicate define.

blocks.zh:
要构建完整的阶段,我们将沿着Gk\ mathcal{G}_{k}的边缘按依赖顺序解决它的上游. 锚作为目标而不是任何上游来源的节点,被放在首位. 然后我们跟踪锚的边缘, 并定位每个源节点 相对于它已经设置的目标。 最后,未受约束的节点在舞台上无上游出现,在剩下的自由空间中取样.
图10说明了扫荡任务的两个阶段的这一进程。 上排的舞台包含接触(刷子,玩具猫)和抓住(手,刷子). 玩具猫是锚,所以它被放在第一位;然后把刷子放在相对它的位置上,这样它就能够使手触摸玩具猫,手被放在从 H 抓取\ mathcal{ 的抓柄上. HQ}_{\mathrm{grasp}}(C.3.2. 灰盆没有出现在这一阶段的上游,在剩余自由空间中取样时间最长。 下排的舞台还额外包含前侧(玩具猫,灰尘潘),因此灰尘潘成为锚:先放置,玩具猫相对,而不内置,刷子和手跟随上.
在最后阶段,我们首先对一个符合目标上游状态的状态进行取样,然后在OmniReset(Yin等人,2026年)之后将其搅拌成近目标状态,因为已经成功的重置提供了不太有用的学习信号。
blocks.en:
To construct a full stage, we resolve its predicates in dependency order along the edges of 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} . The anchor, a node that is the target but not the source of any predicate, is placed first. We then follow the edges from the anchor and place each source node relative to its already placed target. Finally, unconstrained nodes, which appear in no predicate of the stage, are sampled in the remaining free space.
Fig. 10 illustrates this process for two stages of the Sweep task. The stage in the top row contains contact (brush, toy cat) and grasp (hand, brush). The toy cat is the anchor, so it is placed first; the brush is then placed relative to it so that its bristles touch the toy cat, and the hand is placed on the brush handle at a grasp from ℋ grasp \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{grasp}} (Sec. C.3.2 ). The dustpan appears in no predicate of this stage and is sampled last in the remaining free space. The stage in the bottom row additionally contains pre-inside (toy cat, dustpan), so the dustpan becomes the anchor: it is placed first, the toy cat is placed relative to it without being inside it, and the brush and the hand follow as above.
For the final stage, we first sample a state that satisfies the goal predicate and then perturb it into a near-goal state, following OmniReset ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , since an already successful reset provides less useful learning signal.

blocks.zh: C.3.2 引力合成
blocks.en: C.3.2 Grasp Synthesis

blocks.zh: 一个有效的把握对阶段性重现至关重要:每个包含把握的阶段都预示着一个安全持有的物体,因此一个无效的把握会使所有它们失效. 我们用Dexonomy(Chen et al.,2025a)来合成选手,它用机器人手、物体网和33型分类学的抓取类型,并返回这种类型的各种抓取。 当物体有抓取区域(Appendix B.4)时,我们把合成限制在那个区域,这样,例如,刷子被抓在它的手柄上,而不是它的支架上. 对于每个抓取,我们也存储手指指令 q cmd q_{\mathrm{cmd}}} 关闭对象上的手,并在初始化时与手配置一起恢复. 通过线性地将手指关节插到开阔的配置上,达到30-90%的抓取配置,并沿其接近轴将手收回1-5厘米,从而获得相应的抓取前状态。
blocks.en: A valid grasp is critical for stage-wise resets: every stage that contains grasp presupposes a securely held object, so an invalid grasp invalidates all of them. We synthesize grasp candidates with Dexonomy ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , which takes a robot hand, an object mesh, and a grasp type from a 33-type taxonomy, and returns diverse grasps of that type. When the object has a grasp region (Appendix B.4 ), we restrict the synthesis to that region, so that, for example, the brush is grasped at its handle rather than its bristles. For each grasp, we also store the finger command q cmd q_{\mathrm{cmd}} that closes the hand on the object and restore it at initialization together with the hand configuration. The corresponding pre-grasp state is obtained by linearly interpolating the finger joints toward the open configuration, to 30–90% of the grasp configuration, and retracting the hand by 1–5 cm along its approach axis.

blocks.zh: 图11:在扫荡任务中,对重置候选人进行实物核查. (1)和(2)(顶部:通过,底部:失败),和(3)对抓取类型强制执行. (1)场景碰撞:机器人不会与桌子或其他物体发生无效的接触;失败的候选者会与尘粒碰撞. (2) 重置稳定性 :物体在重力下安顿,被抓住的物体留在手中,置于外部扳手之下;失败的抓取会放下刷子. (3) 目标兼容性:目标关系与候选人的把握仍然可以实现;失败的候选人不能将玩具猫带到允许的尘土区。
blocks.en: Figure 11 : Physical verification of reset candidates in the Sweep task. (1) and (2) (top: pass, bottom: fail), and (3) is enforced over grasp types. (1) Scene collision : the robot makes no invalid contact with the table or other objects; the failing candidate collides with the dustpan. (2) Reset stability : objects settle under gravity and the grasped object stays in the hand under external wrenches; the failing grasp drops the brush. (3) Goal compatibility : the goal relation remains attainable with the candidate grasp; the failing candidate cannot bring the toy cat inside the allowed region of the dustpan.

blocks.zh: C.3.3 过渡的可行性和物理有效性
blocks.en: C.3.3 Transition Feasibility and Physical Validity

blocks.zh: 满足一个阶段的上游状态不能保证一个国家在任务后期仍然可以使用。 因此,我们检查在掌握和阶段层面的兼容性,并核实每个州。
blocks.en: Satisfying the predicates of one stage does not guarantee that a state remains usable later in the task. We therefore check compatibility at the grasp and stage levels, and verify every state physically.

blocks.zh: 格拉斯普级. 孤立地稳定的把握可能仍然将手放在一个无法完成其余任务的配置中。 当物体被捡到但后期失败时,一些抓取是有效的. 例如,当一个物体必须放在一个狭小的容器内时,一个将整个物体包裹起来的夹子将它安全地固定在皮卡上,但将手指带入与瞄准镜上的容器相撞. 因为抓住后的每一阶段都继承同样的抓住,这样的抓住使得所有这些阶段都无法使用. 因此,我们选择把握它们与整个任务的一致性,而不是仅靠稳定。 对于每一种抓取类型,我们都会在包含抓取的每个阶段即时进行其候选人,并应用下面的物理检查. 我们按通过所有这些阶段的候选人的分数对抓取类型进行排序,顶级-n n 类型(n = 4 n = 4)的候选人组成抓取集 H 抓取\ mathcal{ (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). HQQMathrm{ grassp}}. 持有对象但不能实现目标关系的格拉斯普类型,如图11(3)中的那一类,获得较低的通过率,被排除在外. 因此,所形成的抓获套装以整个任务为条件,而不仅仅以每个抓获是否掌握了目标为条件。
blocks.en: Grasp level. A grasp that is stable in isolation may still place the hand in a configuration from which the rest of the task cannot be completed. Some grasps are valid when the object is picked up but fail in later stages. For example, when an object must be placed inside a narrow container, a grasp that wraps the whole object holds it securely at pickup, but brings the fingers into collision with the container at the goal. Because every stage after the grasp inherits the same grasp, such a grasp makes all of these stages unusable. We therefore select grasps by their compatibility with the whole task rather than by stability alone. For each grasp type, we instantiate its candidates in every stage that contains grasp and apply the physical checks below. We rank the grasp types by the fraction of candidates that pass across all such stages, and the candidates of the top- n n types ( n = 4 n=4 ) form the grasp set ℋ grasp \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{grasp}} . Grasp types that hold the object but cannot attain the goal relation, such as the one in Fig. 11 (3), receive a low pass rate and are excluded. The resulting grasp set is therefore conditioned on the entire task, not only on how well each grasp holds the object.

blocks.zh: 阶段级别。 独立地对每个阶段进行取样,可以产生满足自己阶段图的状态,但不能导致下一阶段。 例如,一个预加压状态可能会将一个手柄指向远离机器人的锅放入其中,因为在那里无法对下一阶段进行验证的把握. 这类国家在当地是有效的,但无法承担整个任务。 我们从进球阶段开始,通过产生落后阶段来防止它们。 在K阶段状态得到核实后,我们把其锚物的姿势和抓住物带入K阶段−1k-1,只将其余实体重新模拟在K阶段−1k-1的上游。 因此,每个阶段的k− 1 k-1都是围绕一个经过实际核实的阶段kk状态构建的,而不是孤立地构建的,因此,政策总是可以从一个阶段向另一个阶段发展。
blocks.en: Stage level. Sampling each stage independently can produce states that satisfy their own stage graph yet cannot lead to the next stage. For example, a pre-grasp state might place a pan with its handle pointing away from the robot, where no verified grasp of the next stage is reachable. Such states are valid locally but ill-posed for the task as a whole. We prevent them by generating the stages backward, starting from the goal stage. After the states of stage k k are verified, we carry the poses of their anchor objects and their grasps into stage k − 1 k-1 , and resample only the remaining entities under the predicates of stage k − 1 k-1 . Each state of stage k − 1 k-1 is thus constructed around a physically verified state of stage k k rather than in isolation, so the policy can always progress from one stage to the next.

blocks.zh: 物理有效性. 每个候选状态在模拟全机器人时被即时化,必须通过两次检查(图11). (1)场景碰撞:机器人不会与桌子或其他物体发生无效接触. (2)重置稳定性 :在6 s 插曲结尾处,所有物体都处于最后2 s 的休止状态,在把握状态下,物体仍然由至少两个手链所持有. 目标兼容性是在掌握级别上而不是在每个状态下执行的:在目标阶段,候选人无法实现目标关系的掌握类型没有通过这些检查,被上文的排名删除(图11(3))。 所有检查都使用域随机化中最糟糕的物理参数,最大质量和最小摩擦(Appendix B.4 ),这样经核实的状态在随机化范围内依然有效. 在重置生成前,每抓一次固态性被验证:只有手和物体,抓住物体必须在6个方向的重力下,在Min QQ(0.5 m max g,0.5 N)\min(0.5\,m_{\max}g,\,0.5\,\text{N}的外力下,沿六轴各有一个0.02 m的杠杆. 每个抓取类型在所有抓取阶段的通过率提供了以上抓取水平的排名,只有通过所有检查的状态才能保留并传播到前一个阶段.
blocks.en: Physical validity. Every candidate state is instantiated in simulation with the full robot and must pass two checks (Fig. 11 ). (1) Scene collision : the robot makes no invalid contact with the table or other objects. (2) Reset stability : at the end of a 6 s episode, all objects have been at rest for the last 2 s, and in grasped states the object is still held by at least two hand links. Goal compatibility is enforced at the grasp level rather than per state: grasp types whose candidates cannot attain the goal relation fail these checks in the goal stage and are removed by the ranking above (Fig. 11 (3)). All checks use the worst-case physical parameters of the domain randomization, the maximum mass and the minimum friction (Appendix B.4 ), so that verified states remain valid across the randomized range. Grasp robustness is verified once per grasp before reset generation: with only the hand and the object, the grasp must hold the object under gravity in six directions and under an external force of min ⁡ ( 0.5 ​ m max ​ g , 0.5 ​ N ) \min(0.5\,m_{\max}g,\,0.5\,\text{N}) with a 0.02 m lever along each of the six axes. The pass rate of each grasp type across all grasped stages provides the ranking at the grasp level above, and only states that pass all checks are retained and propagated backward to the previous stage.

blocks.zh: C.4 分级分解与QP低位分解.
blocks.en: C.4 Hierarchical decomposition with a QP low level.

blocks.zh: 零镜头的sim-to-Real 部署可以使机器人暴露在在模拟训练中难以预料的硬件特定限制下. 例如,过度的联动速度可能导致不安全的运动,而模拟中无害的接触则会损害物理系统. 在我们的设定中,武吉一号手对接器和桌子之间的接触可以使对接器脱离机器人.
blocks.en: Zero-shot sim-to-real deployment can expose the robot to hardware-specific constraints that are difficult to anticipate during simulation training. For example, excessive joint velocities may lead to unsafe motions, while contacts that are benign in simulation can damage the physical system. In our setup, contact between the Wuji 1 hand coupler and the table can disengage the coupler from the robot.

blocks.zh: 为了适应部署时的安全限制而不对政策进行再培训,我们把学到的任务空间控制与有限的联合空间执行分开。 经过之前的工作(谢等人,2022年;甘加普尔瓦拉等人,2022年;邦等人,2024年),我们让RL政策在任务空间中发挥作用,并将动态分辨率委托给一个基于模型的低级控制器. 具体来说,我们采用了李等人(2026年a)的QP速度-IK配方,该配方将政策的掌状和指尖速度指令映射到受运动和安全限制的联合速度。
blocks.en: To accommodate deployment-time safety constraints without retraining the policy, we separate learned task-space control from constrained joint-space execution. Following prior work ( Xie et al., 2022 , Gangapurwala et al., 2022 , Bang et al., 2024 ) , we let the RL policy act in task space and delegate kinematic resolution to a model-based low-level controller. Specifically, we adopt the QP velocity-IK formulation of Lee et al. (2026a) , which maps the policy’s palm and fingertip velocity commands to joint velocities subject to kinematic and safety constraints.

blocks.zh: 图12说明了为什么这种分离对我们的物理系统有用。 没有手表的清除限制, 学习到的政策可以把武吉一号手对接器推到桌子上, 增加清除限制可防止这种不经过额外政策培训的失败模式。 因此,质量控制方案提供了一种机制,在保留经过模拟培训的任务空间政策的同时,纳入针对部署的硬件和安全要求。
blocks.en: Figure 12 illustrates why this separation is useful in our physical system. Without the hand–table clearance constraint, the learned policy can drive the Wuji 1 hand coupler into the table, which we observed to disengage the coupler during real-world execution. Adding the clearance constraint prevents this failure mode without additional policy training. Thus, the QP provides a mechanism for incorporating deployment-specific hardware and safety requirements while preserving the task-space policy trained in simulation.

blocks.zh: C.5 模拟培训详情
blocks.en: C.5 Simulation Training Details

blocks.zh: 模拟设置. 我们用GPU PhysX管道 在艾萨克西姆和艾萨克实验室培训所有政策 模拟器运行速度为120 120赫兹,政策每12个模拟步骤进行操作,结果控制频率为10 10赫兹. 每集持续16 16s,对应160 160个政策步骤. 在每一个政策步骤上,我们都会在各种平行环境中分批解决Sec.C.4中的QP,以获得所期望的联合速度。 四个被评价的浮雕有22个22个28个动关节和4个或5个指尖。 因此,任务空间行动方面是四指手18 18,五指手21。
blocks.en: Simulation setup. We train all policies in Isaac Sim with Isaac Lab using the GPU PhysX pipeline. The simulator runs at 120 120 Hz, and the policy acts every 12 12 simulation steps, resulting in a control frequency of 10 10 Hz. Each episode lasts 16 16 s, corresponding to 160 160 policy steps. At every policy step, we solve the QP in Sec. C.4 in batch across all parallel environments to obtain the desired joint velocities. The four evaluated embodiments have 22 22 – 28 28 actuated joints and four or five fingertips. Accordingly, the task-space action dimension is 18 18 for four-finger hands and 21 21 for five-finger hands.

blocks.zh: 政策优化. 在非对称演员-批评下, 演员只接收部署时可获得的观测结果,并使用单层LSTM,层态化后再使用四层MLP. 评论家是无记忆的,获得特权的模拟状态. 我们对所有任务和表现都采用了同样的优化和网络配置(表9)。
blocks.en: Policy optimization. We optimize the policy with PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) under an asymmetric actor–critic. The actor receives only observations available at deployment and uses a single-layer LSTM with layer normalization followed by a four-layer MLP. The critic is memoryless and receives privileged simulation state. We use the same optimization and network configuration across all tasks and embodiments (Table 9 ).

blocks.zh: E.2 不同嵌套和组合的引力战略
blocks.en: E.2 Diverse Grasp Strategies Across Embodiments and Configurations

blocks.zh: 从人类视频中提取的任务规格并没有规定特定的抓取配置. 相反,我们重置的生成管道将政策暴露于从33型的抓取分类学中提取的多种多指抓取,使得抓取策略能够适应机器人的浮雕和当前对象的配置.
blocks.en: The task specification extracted from the human video does not prescribe a specific grasp configuration. Instead, our reset generation pipeline exposes the policy to diverse multi-finger grasps drawn from the 33-type grasp taxonomy, allowing the grasp strategy to adapt to the robot embodiment and the current object configuration.

blocks.zh: 图18 — — 20显示了为Dol、Can和Stamp任务所学到的有代表性的把握战略。 不同的分解的化身为同一任务实现了不同的抓取类型,反映了其独特的手形形态和运动特征. 此外,即使在同一个化身内,学习到的把握也会随着对象配置的不同而改变. 这些定性结果说明,Dex-One2Many并没有将机器人限制在从人类演示中继承下来的固定把握,而是允许在政策学习过程中出现具体体现和配置的把握策略.
blocks.en: Figures 18 – 20 show representative grasp strategies learned for the Doll, Can, and Stamp tasks. Different dexterous embodiments realize different grasp types for the same task, reflecting their distinct hand morphologies and kinematics. Moreover, even within the same embodiment, the learned grasp can change as the object configuration varies. These qualitative results illustrate that Dex-One2Many does not constrain the robot to a fixed grasp inherited from the human demonstration, but instead allows embodiment- and configuration-specific grasp strategies to emerge during policy learning.
